left.title: Acme X1 gateway released
left.body: Acme announced the X1 gateway. The gateway supports Matter and Thread alongside Ethernet and Wi-Fi. Administrators can configure local processing without cloud services. The documented integration interface connects existing monitoring systems. Installation instructions and a maintenance guide accompany the official release. The gateway has 2 ports and supports local installation.
